name: לָשַׁע
summary: Lasha is the last place named in the description of the Canaanite boundary. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The repeated עַד marks the reach of the boundary, first “as far as Gaza” and finally “as far as Lasha.”

note: Moved from the former word entry `laaxa3`. The old root key לשע recorded the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is uncertain.
